description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) SALVUS ka'tah through the real unit_selected_to_shoot window (WP-C3). Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes, round 2): the Command-phase load readies the Custodes, then the scenario enters the Shooting phase. Setup privileges: Gretchin C have the benefit of cover (stratagem_cover, the per-attack path terrain cover uses — 13.08 worsens every attack's BS by 1), CP 0 for both players, auto wound allocation. (1) The Caladius Grav-tank (BS 2+) is selected to shoot: the window opens with the 0-CP SALVUS card. (2) A real click on 'Use on Caladius Grav-Tank': no CP, the tank is no longer readied, Salvus active. (3) Its Iliastus accelerator cannon shoots the Gretchin: the staged hit roll keeps BS 2+ (no '(cover)' penalty) and the dice log names 'Salvus (Ka'tah)'. The B case (same shot without Salvus rolls at 3+ (cover)) is pinned by cover_hit_label_wound_reroll_11e and test_custodes_army_rules_11e.gd D2.

steps.script:
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.units["U_GRETCHIN_C"]["flags"]["stratagem_cover"] = true
return true
